subject: Your Brain's Immune System Is Being Replaced—Starting at 50
script: From Agewell Brief: Your Brain's Immune System Is Being Replaced—Starting at 50. New single-cell mapping reveals a hidden midlife overhaul in the hippocampus: resident microglia decline, inflammatory replacements arrive, and the blood-brain barrier weakens. Here's what that means for your healthspan. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
